name: audit-an-intact-strain-gene-called-a-pseudogene
turns: PlasmoDB calls PfNF54_100037200 a pseudogene in P. falciparum NF54, while its 3D7 ortholog PF3D7_1032400 is a protein coding gene. Is the NF54 pseudogene call right?
rationale: A positive of the answer key: the NF54 model of this gene is called a pseudogene, and the served data show an intact gene. The audit keeps the error on the NF54 gene and names the pseudogene call as its cause.
